## Frequently Asked Questions
- Q: What is GameZipper Tools? A: GameZipper Tools is a free collection of 2,466+ browser-based online utilities for developers, designers, content creators, and everyday tasks. Includes text tools, developer tools (JSON, Base64, regex, cURL converter, JWT, hash), color tools, image tools, CSS generators, calculators (snow-day-calculator), converters (QR, unit, base, password), social tools, and Chinese fortune/mystic tools.
- Q: Do these tools require sign-up or installation? A: No. Every tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript and Web APIs. No sign-up, no account, no download, no backend server. Your data stays on your device.
- Q: Is GameZipper Tools free? A: Yes — every tool is free to use without limits. Supported by unobtrusive ads.
- Q: What can the cURL Converter do? A: The [cURL Converter](https://tools.gamezipper.com/dev/curl-converter.html) transforms a cURL command into executable code in 10 languages: JavaScript fetch, axios, XHR, Node.js, Python requests, Go net/http, PHP cURL, Ruby Net::HTTP, C# HttpClient, and Java HttpURLConnection.
- Q: How does the Synonym Finder work? A: The [Synonym Finder](https://tools.gamezipper.com/text/synonym-finder.html) is an offline thesaurus with 200,000+ curated entries across 50 headwords. It returns perfect synonyms, near synonyms, antonyms, and related words with click-to-copy chips and live suggestions.
- Q: What is the Snow Day Calculator? A: The [Snow Day Calculator](https://tools.gamezipper.com/calc/snow-day-calculator.html) uses a weighted multi-factor model (snowfall 40%, ice 30%, wind chill 15%, forecast conditions 10%, region 5%) to predict the probability of a school or office closure on a given day. Supports 7 region profiles, day-of-week multipliers, and shareable URL state.
